column1: # Air combat redesign (2026-10-20): aircraft, anti-air vehicles and runway airfield.
Aircraft service: 4 jet stands, 2 helipads · rearm and repair
column2: 航空维修：4 个喷气机停机位、2 个直升机坪 · 补给弹药并维修

column1: Runway airfield. Builds drones, helicopters, fighters and bombers; jets park, rearm and repair on 4 stands, rotorcraft on 2 helipads. Uses 8 power.
column2: 跑道机场。生产无人机、直升机、战斗机与轰炸机；喷气机在 4 个停机位停放、补给与维修，旋翼机使用 2 个直升机坪。消耗 8 电力。

column1: Shoulder-launched rockets break heavy armor and structures; guided missiles lock onto aircraft. Slow reload, weak against infantry.
column2: 肩射火箭克制重装甲与建筑，制导导弹可锁定飞机；装填较慢，不擅长对付步兵。

column1: Multirole jet. Guided missiles deal full damage to air and ground targets; close-range cannon support. Lands at its airfield to rearm.
column2: 多用途喷气战机。制导导弹对空中与地面目标造成全额伤害，机炮提供近程支援。返回机场降落补给弹药。

column1: Heavy level bomber. High bomb damage, doubled against buildings. One stick per sortie; needs fighter escort.
column2: 重型水平轰炸机。炸弹伤害高，对建筑造成双倍伤害。每次出击投下一串炸弹；需要战斗机护航。

column1: No free stand · every jet parks and rearms on its own stand.
column2: 没有空闲停机位 · 每架喷气机都需在自己的停机位停放与补给。

column1: Free an aircraft stand to resume this queue.
column2: 腾出一个停机位以继续此生产队列。

column1: Expendable loitering munition. Scouts while hovering; an attack order sends it diving into a vehicle or structure as its own warhead. Holds fire by default.
column2: 一次性巡飞弹。悬停时可侦察；下达攻击命令后会以自身为弹头俯冲撞向车辆或建筑。默认不开火。

column1: Attack helicopter. Rockets against ground forces while hovering in place; reloads on cooldown in the field. Vulnerable to rocket infantry and anti-air.
column2: 武装直升机。悬停原地用火箭打击地面部队；在战场上按冷却时间重新装弹。易被火箭步兵与防空火力击落。

column1: Mobile air defense on a tank chassis. Ground damage: 33% (100% with Dual-purpose AA). Escort it with tanks and infantry.
column2: 坦克底盘的机动防空单位。对地伤害为 33%，研究两用防空后提升至 100%。需要坦克与步兵护卫。
拦截模式 · 对地 %d%% 伤害

column1: AA vehicles, AA turrets and Helix Interception deal 100% ground damage instead of 33%. Applies to existing and new units. Air damage is unchanged; AA turrets always prioritize aircraft.
column2: 防空载具、防空炮塔与螺旋拦截模式的对地伤害从 33% 提升至 100%。适用于现有及新造单位，对空伤害不变；防空炮塔始终优先攻击航空器。
两用防空 · 对地 100% 伤害
